missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Причина' is the nominative subject, and 'неизвестна' is the short feminine predicate agreeing with it. 'Пожара' is genitive, naming what was caused.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Причину' is the accusative direct object of 'нашла'. 'Настоящую' is the feminine accusative adjective agreeing with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after много. The quantity word 'много' takes the genitive plural 'причин'. The frame 'у этой болезни' shows what they belong to.
Strategic focus: Dative after каждый. 'Причине' is dative, governed by 'каждой', within the idiom 'придавать значение'. The phrase weighs every cause.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after недоволен. The short adjective 'недоволен' requires the instrumental, giving 'причиной'. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. After 'в' the noun takes the prepositional form 'причине'. 'Есть смысл' uses the nominative, judging the cause reasonable.
Strategic focus: Dative in a set phrase. The idiom 'по причине' takes the dative 'причине'. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine dative, explaining the lateness.
Strategic focus: Genitive after без. The preposition 'без' takes the genitive 'причины'. The clause notes the absence of any reason for his no-show.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Причины' is the nominative plural subject, and 'известны' is the short plural predicate. 'Главные' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Причины' is the accusative plural object of 'изучают', matching the nominative plural for inanimates. 'Землетрясений' is genitive plural.
